Title: 502138-2026: France – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Design competition (maîtrise d'oeuvre) for the construction of a new gym facility on the Galinou site and urban and landscape development of its immediate surroundings in Albi
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Construction of a new sports hall with urban and landscape planning services is potentially interesting for sbp as a sports building/long-span structure and includes engineering services. However, as this is an architectural competition in France (not DACH) without specific structural details, the immediate relevance is limited.
titel: Competition for the design of a new sports hall on the Galinou site with adjacent urban and open-space design in Albi
kurzbeschreibung: Architectural and planning competition for a new sports hall in Albi.
umfang: Construction of a new sports or gymnastics building on the Galinou site as well as urban development and landscape design of the immediate surroundings; the notice does not provide any information on GFA, spans, capacities or structural key figures.
leistungen: Competition for design services of the maîtrise d'oeuvre for the construction of a new sports building including adjacent urban and landscape design; specific specialist lots, service phases or shares of structural design are not stated.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Sports buildings are generally of interest for sbp.
• This is an early-stage design competition, which allows a strategic entry via architectural teams.
• However, the notice does not mention any special structural features, spans or complex roof structures.
• The focus also appears to be partly on urban and open-space design, which reduces the direct fit.
• No explicit tender for structural design or civil engineering services.
• France is a relevant European market, but without identifiable unique technical features this is only of medium priority.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. Essential information such as GFA, hall size, spectator capacity, type of structure, level of fit-out and scope of external works is missing for a reliable estimate. At most, for a municipal new sports hall with surrounding measures, a rough estimate in the mid single- to double-digit million range could be conceivable, but this is not sufficiently reliable.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee is explicitly stated. As neither chargeable costs nor scope of services, structural share or remuneration model are specified, no reliable fee estimate is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the tender documents; the notice itself does not state any specific requirements for references or qualifications.
auftraggeber: Mairie d'Albi, 16 rue de l'hôtel de ville, 81000 Albi, France, contact: Madame le Maire, e-mail: nicolas.roullet@mairie-albi.fr, phone: +33 563491398, website: https://albi.fr/
notes: Competitive procedure, restricted. Duration 28 months. EU funding via ERDF 2021/2027 applied for. Tender documents: https://webmarche.adullact.org/entreprise/consultation/505700?orgAcronyme=81ALBI. The notice does not contain any information on number of participants, prize money, GFA or technical key figures.
